name: g_spriteTextures
notes: Sprite index -> texture id (DrawSprite2D). For example sprite 0x6E2 -> texture 0xDA4.

name: g_jobHandlers
notes: Handler table used by DispatchJob (0x41D670).

name: g_inputJoystickButtonMap
notes: Button bits for joystick buttons 0..13 (initialized data), read by ReadJoystick.

name: g_inputPlayer1Mode
notes: Device mode of player 1 (see ResolveControllerModes). High bit: the joystick is a gun. Followed by SEGAJOY gun state at 0x587D18.

name: g_inputGunProductName
notes: "MC PC LIGHT GUN". EnumJoystickCallback marks a player mode as gun when the joystick product name equals this.

name: g_frameCorrectionStepMs
notes: 0.2 in the file. Step for the frame time correction.

name: g_frameCorrectionLimitMs
notes: 10.0 in the file. The correction g_frameCorrectionMs is clamped to +/- this value.

name: g_frameTimeMs
notes: Target frame time, 16.6667 (= 1000/60) in the file. Read at 0x4A4B8F. Only the initial value is confirmed.

name: g_targetFps
notes: 60 in the file.

name: g_frameCorrectionThresholdMs
notes: 20 in the file. Threshold used when deciding the frame time correction.

name: g_frameCorrectionPeriodMs
notes: 333 in the file. Period of the frame time correction decision.

name: g_defaultHglCoreIniName
notes: Points to the default file name "hglCore.ini" used by GetHglCoreIniPath.

name: g_viewMatrix
notes: Constant view matrix diag(1, 1, -1, 1), set once per frame with SetTransform(VIEW) by 0x4A6A60. Model matrices are therefore camera-space matrices.

name: g_jobQueueRead
notes: Read index of g_jobQueue. The queue is empty when it equals g_jobQueueWrite. Code: hod2::kJobQueueReadIndex.

name: g_jobQueueWrite
notes: Write index of g_jobQueue. Code: hod2::kJobQueueWriteIndex.

name: g_jobQueue
notes: Ring buffer of 64 entries, 16 bytes each, processed by ProcessJobQueueEntry. Entry layout unknown.

name: g_inputPlayer2Index
notes: Hod2.ini PLAYER2_INDEX. 0x7D98E8 and 0x7D98F0 hold PLAYER1_DEVID and PLAYER2_DEVID.

name: g_inputSlotStates
notes: Per-slot state linked from the player records. UpdateInput writes the record type at +0 and 2 at +0x11. Start of the memory the input update writes (to 0x7DB370).

name: g_inputReloadFlags
notes: Set from the mouse reload press (and by the gun readers); consumed by TakeShotFlags.

name: g_inputKeyChars
notes: DIK code -> character for text entry (mode 2). Filled elsewhere.

name: g_inputKeyState
notes: Keyboard GetDeviceState buffer.

name: g_inputJoystickPrevious
notes: Previous held bits per joystick for the pressed/released edges.

name: g_inputCursor
notes: Aim position per slot in client pixels; (0xFFFF, 0xFFFF) = off screen.

name: g_inputPlayer1Index
notes: Hod2.ini PLAYER1_INDEX.

name: g_inputMouseRecord
notes: Raw mouse record (0x34 bytes).

name: g_inputKeyboardRecords
notes: Raw keyboard records for layout 0 and 1.

name: g_inputJoystickRecords
notes: Raw joystick records.

name: g_inputKeyEvents
notes: Buffered keyboard data. Cleared and read again by each ReadKeyboard call.

name: g_inputTriggerFlags
notes: Set from the mouse trigger press (and by the gun readers); consumed by TakeShotFlags.

name: g_inputNameEntry
notes: Text entry: modifier bits at +0, up to 7 characters at +2 (+2 = 1 on overflow).

name: g_diDevices
notes: Joystick devices created by EnumJoystickCallback (0x41E9A0), count in g_inputJoystickCount. SetCooperativeLevel(g_hWnd, DISCL_EXCLUSIVE | DISCL_BACKGROUND) at 0x41EBA3.

name: g_inputPlayerRecords
notes: Player input records; P1 uses slot 0, P2 slot 6. +0x30 points to the slot state.

name: g_inputPlayer2Mode
notes: Device mode of player 2.

name: g_inputKeyboard
notes: Keyboard device.

name: g_inputMouse
notes: Mouse device.

name: g_inputJoystickCount
notes: Number of joysticks in g_diDevices.

name: g_inputCursorCallback
notes: One-shot int (__cdecl*)(void) set by SetCursorCallback and called by ConsumeCursorCallback.

name: g_inputKeyboardPrevious
notes: Previous held bits, shared by both keyboard layouts.

name: g_inputMousePrevious
notes: Previous held bits of the mouse.

name: g_cdCheckMode
notes: CheckCdRom passes immediately when this is 0. Meaning unknown.

name: g_hWnd
notes: Main window handle, stored at 0x4A588D from CreateWindowExA. Window class and title are both "The House of the Dead 2".

name: g_d3dDevice
notes: Direct3D 7 device used for transforms, render states and DrawPrimitive.

name: g_frameWaitCallback
notes: Function pointer called by WaitFrameEnd with the remaining ms on every spin; void __cdecl (float). Set to FrameWaitCallback at 0x49DF0B. Code: hod2::kFrameWaitCallbackSlot.

name: g_hglCoreFlags
notes: hglCore.ini flag bits set by LoadHglCoreIni. Bit table in docs/work/reverse-engineering.md.

name: g_frameCorrectionMs
notes: Accumulated frame time correction, clamped to +/- 10 ms.

name: g_lastFrameQpcLow
notes: Low 32 bits of the QueryPerformanceCounter value of the previous frame.

name: g_qpcFrequency
notes: QueryPerformanceFrequency value.

name: g_hglCoreIniPath
notes: Full path of hglCore.ini written by GetHglCoreIniPath.

name: g_projectionMatrix
notes: Copy of the projection matrix made by SetMatrixMode; DrawScreenQuad reads m22/m32 (+0x28, +0x38) for quad depth.

name: g_currentMatrix
notes: Current matrix of the engine matrix stack.

name: g_matrixMode
notes: 3 = projection.

name: g_textureSizes
notes: Pointer to {width, height} per texture id, read by DrawScreenQuad for the quad size.

name: g_textureSizes2
notes: Same as g_textureSizes for texture ids with the high bit set.

name: g_focalLengthPx
notes: 240 / tan(half vertical fov) = about 640: focal length in 640x480 pixels, used by about 30 functions for software projection and the shot ray.

name: g_modelTable
notes: Model table: +4 model pointer, +0xC flags (0x8000 | 1 = drawable). Entry 0x93E is the letterbox bar (a static model at 0x894D20 in the tested run).

name: g_projectionOffset
notes: Projection centre offset in normalized device coordinates (SetProjectionCenter).

name: g_shotInput
notes: Per player shot input from UpdateShots: +0/+2 screen x/y (shorts), +0x12 on screen, +0x14 fired.

name: g_cinemaMode
notes: Set to 1 while the letterbox is shown (UpdateLetterbox); shot handling (0x414A10, 0x40D000) reads it.

name: g_aim
notes: Per player aim: +0/+2 raw x/y, +4/+6 centred aim (shorts), +8/+0xC centred aim (floats), +0x10 valid, +0x12 on screen, +0x14 fired, +0x16 calibration.

name: g_letterboxState
notes: UpdateLetterbox state: 0 show, 1 slide in, 3 slide out, 4 hold, 5 show and leave cinema mode, 6 hide, 7 restore, 8 full cover.
